propositions: SnapshotHandle._cleanup field is declared but never assigned by any producer in src/
SnapshotHandle.__exit__ is a permanent no-op because _cleanup is always None
No caller in src/ or tests/ uses SnapshotHandle as a context manager
The presence of __enter__/__exit__ and _cleanup misleads readers into thinking handle cleanup releases resources when it does not
Snapshot entry lifetime is managed by the janitor/GC, not by the handle itself
